name: .338 Cal-200gr Stone Hammer®

slowestTwist.raw: Minimum required twist rate is 1-13″ or faster

note: Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "We designed this pure copper bullet for the 338 Marlin Express lever action. Designed with the 3mm hollow point and extra thickness around the meplat, for riding in a tubular magazine, that has proven to be spectacular in terminal performance. With a minimum required twist rate of 1-13″ or faster this Stone Hammer™ bullet will be an excellent choice for pretty much any .338 caliber cartridge on any big game."
